requirements.label: GCE A levels · selection aggregate
requirements.details: Add the best three subject grades. The university assigns A*=6, A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2 and E=1. Singapore-Cambridge grades use a separate H1/H2 scale.

source.title: UWA 2027 international guide · undergraduate qualifications (p. 117)

requirements.label: AP · exams and recognised high-school qualification
requirements.details: Submit US College Board-certified results and an accepted secondary qualification. Count AP results graded at least 3 from two consecutive academic years. At least two qualifying exams are required.

source.title: UWA AP entry and subject equivalents

requirements.label: IB · university English-language options
requirements.details: The standard English-language route accepts IB English A Literature or Language and Literature at grade 4 SL or 3 HL, Literature and Performance at 4 SL, or English B at 5 HL. Courses with their own English standard can require more.

source.title: UWA IB diploma English rules

requirements.label: English evidence · standard and higher course requirements
requirements.details: The standard IELTS Academic reference is 6.5 overall with every band at least 6.0. Check programme-specific higher requirements. The guide also lists accepted alternative tests and school qualifications.

source.title: UWA 2027 international guide · English evidence (p. 118)

requirements.label: ATAR 70 equivalent · GCE A levels and Singapore-Cambridge
